a1WorkingStepExplanation.rootCause: The current project has 64 HERO spriteSheet steps, but A1 emitted exactly one report/QA slot at real index 0 for each of the 60 HERO actions. Its generator therefore flattened multi-step presets to one current step per action. The four omitted current slots belong to d_devouring_eclipse indexes 1, 2, 3 and ni_silent_assassin index 1.

qaStateConsistency.note: The A1 JSON is an execution record, but its 60 QA proposals are not present in the currently visible Lab state.

currentLive.reason: No current QA overrides are visible; each of the 60 A1 presentation proposals lacks a matching live override.

previewBridge.nextFixOnly: Restart the Vite development server with MEGA_PACK_ROOT set to the Mega Pack root used by the preview index; then retry the same GET endpoint.
